references.text: The law about helping your enemy's donkey or ox that has gone astray and bringing it back to its owner
Regulations concerning returning what is found or entrusted to you, and the requirement to return it to the rightful owner
The preceding verse dealing with the duty to bring lost animals back to your brother
Continuation of the law about caring for and returning lost property, including donkeys, clothing, and other items
The golden rule: do to others what you would have them do to you, reflecting the principle of helping your neighbor
Jesus' teaching on treating others as you yourself want to be treated, in line with the principle of caring for others' property
